headline: US Fines Air France and KLM Over Flights in Prohibited Iraqi Airspace
summary: United States authorities issued fines against Air France and KLM for operating commercial flights through prohibited Iraqi airspace.
why: Aviation regulators enforce strict safety corridors over conflict zones to protect commercial aircraft from geopolitical security risks.

impacts.name: Air France-KLM
impacts.why: Regulatory penalties and fines create direct compliance costs and minor financial headwinds for airlines.
